title: Message envelope
description: Common wrapper for every command (SQS) and event (EventBridge `detail`). The message-specific payload goes in `data`.

message_id.description: Unique per message. Consumers use it to ignore duplicate deliveries and replays.

message_type.description: Command or event name, e.g. ReserveFlight or FlightReserved. See catalog.md.

message_version.description: Payload version. Bumped on breaking changes to `data`.

occurred_at.description: When the command was sent or the fact happened, in UTC (ISO 8601).

correlation_id.description: The trip ID (trp_...), or vendor:<name> for circuit breaker events.

task_token.description: Commands only: the Step Functions task token to answer with. Never logged.
